prompt: Create a map with data from a URL and style it.
criteria: Must call create_map() to create a new map
Must call upload_url() to upload data from a URL
Must call skill.wait_for_layer_processing() to wait for layer to complete processing
Must call skill.inspect_created_map() to inspect the map (this outputs IDs and writes context.json automatically)
Must include a comment that marks the separation between Stage 1 (creation) and Stage 2 (styling)
Must call update_layer_style() with FSL styling
